t: Automatically adjusts to the cable size to strip the insulation without damaging the conductor. Can be used for single, multiple and fine stranded cables 0.2-6.0mm² with standard insulation. Suitable for copper and aluminium wire up to 2.5mm² and features an adjustable length stop from 6.0-18.0mm. Made from fibreglass-reinforced plastic with ergonomic soft plastic gripping zones in the handle for added grip and comfort.
